title: Sidra Clothing & Shoes
tagline: A React storefront with the admin behind it
description: A working fashion storefront built in React: a catalogue of 132 products with brand, category, gender and price filters, sorting, search with pagination, product pages with size picker and customer reviews, wishlist, cart, checkout and order history. Accounts work too — register, sign in, and your wishlist and orders follow you.
priceNote: setup included · your branding, products and copy
highlights: Four admin screens: dashboard, products, orders and customers
Admin opens with no password — nothing sits behind it to protect
Its totals are computed from the same catalogue the shop serves, so the two cannot disagree
132 products, filterable by brand, category, gender and price, with search and sorting
Wishlist, cart, checkout and order history that persist while you browse
Runs with no server at all: the whole API answers inside the page

access.label: Admin dashboard
access.note: Linked from the footer of every shop page. No sign-in: this build has no database and no API, so there is nothing behind it for a password to protect. Register any email on the shop and the new account shows up in Customers.
